command: set -eu; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; id -un; echo '===SERVICE==='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p InactiveEnterTimestamp || true; echo '===MACHINECTL==='; machinectl status entityos --no-pager || true; echo '===MACHINECTL_LIST==='; machinectl list --no-pager || true; echo '===NSPAWN_PS==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,user,lstart,stat,args | grep -E '[s]ystemd-nspawn|[s]ystemd --system' || true; echo '===ROOTFS_MOUNTS==='; findmnt -R /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run || true; echo '===ROOTFS_USERS_TOP==='; sudo fuser -vm /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run 2>&1 | head -80 || true; echo '===LSNS_MATCH==='; sudo lsns -o NS,TYPE,PATH,NPROCS,PID,COMMAND 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'entityos|rootfs-run|systemd-nspawn' || true; echo '===MACHINE_LEADER==='; machinectl show entityos -p Leader -p State -p Service -p RootDirectory 2>/dev/null || true
